Mall Arauco Maipú

Large western-area mall, a key shopping destination for families in Maipú and Cerrillos. Wide variety of stores, dining and services for a full day out.

Best for

  • Families
  • Variety
  • Western area

Not ideal for

  • Tourists staying in the eastern area without time

Getting there

Close to Las Parcelas station, Line 5.

Recommended time: 2–4 hours
